summary: Good night is GOOD followed by NIGHT, where a bent hand sets down over the other arm like the sun going down.
steps: Sign GOOD: flat hand from the chin to the other palm.
Sign NIGHT: lay your non-dominant arm flat; bend your dominant hand at the wrist and bring it down over the edge of the other arm, like a sunset.
mistakes: Confusing NIGHT with MORNING. NIGHT comes down over the arm; MORNING comes up from under it.
